definition: Hermes Agent is an open-source artificial intelligence agent developed by Nous Research.
details: It is designed to perform autonomous and multi-step tasks using large language models. Hermes Agent can be configured to use both locally hosted and remotely hosted LLMs.

explainer.lead: Hermes Agent is open-source software from Nous Research that uses a large language model to carry out tasks autonomously across multiple steps. It can work with a model running on your own systems or one hosted remotely, giving users flexibility in how they deploy it.

tiers.eli5: Hermes Agent is like a helper that can work through a job with several stages instead of stopping after one answer. You can choose whether its thinking comes from a computer nearby or one far away.
tiers.practitioner: Use Hermes Agent as an open-source agent layer for autonomous, multi-step LLM tasks. Configure it with either a locally hosted or remotely hosted model; the agent itself does not remove the need to choose and operate that underlying LLM.
tiers.paperLevel: Hermes Agent can be represented as an open-source agent A that uses a large language model M to perform autonomous multi-step tasks. The deployment configuration permits M to be hosted locally or remotely.

explainer.example: A user could ask Hermes Agent to outline a topic, draft an explanation from that outline, and then revise the draft. The agent would use its configured local or remote LLM to proceed through those stages as one multi-step task.

usedIn.name: Local LLM setups
usedIn.detail: Hermes Agent can be configured to use a large language model hosted locally.

usedIn.name: Remote LLM setups
usedIn.detail: It can also use a large language model hosted remotely.

explainer.intuition: A language model supplies the underlying language capabilities, while Hermes Agent uses them to pursue a task through multiple steps with less step-by-step direction from the user.
howItWorks: Choose a locally hosted or remotely hosted large language model.
Configure Hermes Agent to use that model.
Give the agent a task that requires multiple steps.
The agent uses the model to work through the task autonomously.
explainer.whyItMatters: It combines autonomous multi-step task execution with a choice of local or remote model hosting. Its open-source development also makes the agent available as an open software project rather than only a closed service.
misconceptions: Hermes Agent is an agent that uses an LLM, not simply another name for the underlying model.
It is not restricted to locally hosted models; remote models are supported too.
Using it does not require the same hosting arrangement for every deployment.

diagram.caption: Hermes Agent takes a multi-step task and uses either a locally or remotely hosted LLM.
